note: Each entry flips one decision the gate is supposed to defend. Half A is selection and the application scale, half B is geometry, the node budget and cleanup. Every entry must still pass `goose check` and must then fail the differential gate; a mutation that does not compile proves nothing.

mutations.note: rank multiplies the scale instead of dividing it
alpha == 0 branch inverted: the caller scale is dropped
rank read from b.ne1 (output width) instead of b.ne0
the weight name is ignored: any pair of the adapter is applied
an applied adapter is reported as skipped
the caller scale is replaced by alpha
delta ne0 reported as the rank instead of the output width
delta ne1 reported as n_embd instead of the token count
the delta drops the third activation dimension
three LoRA nodes per applied adapter instead of four
the delta width guard never fires
cleanup reports the old registry size after the erase
